-- Restore the original immutable-step comparison after readiness fields have
-- been removed from persisted instance payloads by a controlled rollback.
DO $$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM practice_task_instances AS instance,
             jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(instance.payload->'steps','[]'::jsonb)) AS step(step_object)
        WHERE step_object ? 'readiness_receipt' OR step_object ? 'readiness_idempotency_key'
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'cannot roll back readiness receipt support while persisted receipts exist';
    END IF;
END;
$$;
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION practice_runtime_instance_frozen_steps(payload JSONB) RETURNS JSONB LANGUAGE SQL IMMUTABLE AS $$
    SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(step_object - 'status' ORDER BY ordinal), '[]'::jsonb)
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(payload->'steps','[]'::jsonb)) WITH ORDINALITY AS step(step_object,ordinal)
$$;
